exact_target.input: Every finite simple connected undirected UNWEIGHTED cactus graph G with n>=2, and arbitrary integer 0<=k<=n. A cactus has every block an edge or a simple cycle; cycle lengths and number of cycles are unrestricted.
exact_target.objective: For C subset V, GBC_G(C)=sum over ALL ordered pairs s!=t of sigma_st(C)/sigma_st. sigma_st counts ALL shortest s-t paths, and sigma_st(C) counts those meeting C at least once, INCLUDING endpoints.
exact_target.required_output: A k-vertex set attaining the EXACT global maximum of that rational objective, with uniform polynomial total bit time if an algorithm theorem is claimed. No restriction to fixed k, single cycle, odd cycles, unique geodesics, allowed candidate sites, weighted surrogate, approximation or finite table.
exact_target.decision_variant: Given the same G,k and an explicitly binary-encoded rational B, decide whether some k-set has GBC_G(C)>=B. A hardness claim must reduce to THIS unrestricted-site model and give exact thresholds.

frozen_rooted_state.interface: A rooted subcactus H attached to the rest ONLY at portal v, with every internal edge/descendant block retained.
frozen_rooted_state.selection_data: a=|C intersect (V(H) minus {v})| and epsilon=1 if v in C, 0 otherwise. Portal cost is counted once at composition.
frozen_rooted_state.path_avoidance: q_H,C(x,y)=number of shortest H paths from x to y avoiding C, divided by number of ALL shortest H paths. Selected endpoints make q zero.
frozen_rooted_state.alpha: sum over x in V(H) minus {v} of q_H,C(x,v)
frozen_rooted_state.beta: sum over UNORDERED distinct pairs {x,y} subset V(H) of q_H,C(x,y)
frozen_rooted_state.table_to_compress: Achievable exact rational (alpha,beta) at each (a,epsilon), or equivalently the lower envelope F_H,a,epsilon(z)=min_C [beta+z*alpha] for nonnegative outside portal mass z. Prove this exact interface suffices before using it.
frozen_rooted_state.merge_obligation: At an articulation, pairwise cross terms are products of portal masses. Within a cycle, all shortest-arc ties must be retained. Distinct raw alpha values alone do not refute polynomial lower-envelope compression.
